description: Canonical minting engine specification for Engine Search NFTs. Defines locked bones, living tissue, visual binding rules, and the full minting flow. The second organ of the Village — sovereign retrieval.

locked_fields_at_mint.description: Immutable bones — set once at mint, never change.

dynamic_fields_xls46d.description: Living tissue — evolve over time via XLS-46d dynamic metadata.

search_honour_score.purpose: Searcher standing, evolves with search behaviour

bias_index.purpose: Measures ranking bias — 0.0 = perfectly neutral, 1.0 = fully biased

safety_integrity.purpose: Safety compliance — degrades on harmful query patterns

query_safety_flags.purpose: Append-only array of flagged query events

result_alignment_score.purpose: Running average of 7-Leaf alignment across searches

radiant.glow: High teal glow, fast pulse, data streams

amber_dusk.glow: Amber glow, slower pulse, fog drifting

regeneration_cues.crack_heal: Visible crack that heals as honour recovers
regeneration_cues.teal_pulse_surge: Triggered on honour rise after recovery
regeneration_cues.safety_shield_flash: Brief shield icon flash on safety_integrity drop

minting_flow.detail: Check owner_did exists and is active via Wallet entity
Ensure no existing ES-NFT for this DID
Populate locked bones + initial dynamic fields
Set metadata_uri pointing to off-chain JSON-LD
Create MarketplaceListing entry for the searcher

error_handling.INVALID_DID: DID ownership verification fails — no creation
error_handling.DUPLICATE: ES-NFT already exists for this DID
error_handling.ENTITY_ERROR: SearchEngineNFT record creation fails — full rollback
error_handling.REGISTRY_ERROR: NFT minted but registry failed — needs manual repair
error_handling.policy: No partial state. Either fully minted or fully rolled back.

trusted_searcher.privileges: Full access, premium search, email reports
